class AppController extends Controller
{
    use AuthorizesRequests, DispatchesJobs, ValidatesRequests;

    protected $appName;

    public function __construct($appName = null)
    {
        if ($appName != null) {
            $this->appName = $appName;
        }
        $this->middleware(function (Request $request, $next) {

            $path = $request->path();
            //if it's an api route, don't attach this extra info
            if (Str::startsWith($path, ["api/", "guest/"])) {
                return $next($request);
            }

            //make the app name available to all routes
            $this->appName = ucwords(Str::camel($request->segment(1)));

            //translate app-specific ids like "org-chart-123" to app_record_id primary key and swap out the id param
            $id = $request->route('id');
            // does not work for model routes
            $isModelRoute = Str::startsWith($request->route()->getActionMethod(), 'model');
            if ($id != null && !$isModelRoute) {
                $translatedId = $this->translateId($id);
                if ($translatedId === null) {
                    abort(404);
                }
                $request->route()->setParameter('id', $translatedId);
            }
            // if model route and not numeric id param, throw bad request
            if ($isModelRoute && isset($id) && !is_numeric($id)) {
                abort(400);
            }


            //can the person even use this application?
            if (!$this->app()->canUseApplication($request->user())) {
                abort(401,
                    "You don't have authorization to use this application");
            }

            //add the app menu to all views
            if (!Str::contains($request->path(), "autocomplete/")) {
                view()->share("menuItems",
                    $this->app()->menuActions($this->getPerson($request)));
                view()->share("user", $request->user());
                view()->share("person", $this->getPerson($request));
                view()->share("app", $this->app());
            }

            // by default, every view will filter out records that aren't viewable
            View::composer("*", function ($view) use ($request) {
                if ($view->records) {
                    $view->records = $this->app()
                        ->filterViewable($view->records,
                            $this->getPerson($request));
                }
                if ($view->myApprovals) {
                    $view->myApprovals = $this->app()
                        ->filterViewable($view->myApprovals,
                            $this->getPerson($request));
                }
            });

            return $next($request);
        });
    }

    /**
     * Returns an app object instance for the application
     * referred to in the URL prefix (as set by the middleware above)
     */
    public function app()
    {
        return SvnaApp::appFor($this->appName);
    }

    /**
     * Looks for a view with this name in the application's view directory,
     * returns it if it exists, or uses the default if not.
     *
     * This allows for custom per-app views for the standard pages, but
     * will default to the standard index/show/create views if no custom
     * view was specified.
     */
    public function appView($name, $exportCSV = false)
    {
        return $this->app()->appView($name);
    }

    /**
     * Show all.
     */
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $user = $request->user();
        // This is for <x-svna-table>
        if ($request->wantsJson()) {

			$query = $this->filteredViewable($request);
            $pageLength = (int) ($request->attributes->get('paginate_length_override') ?? config("svna.paginate_length"));

            if (null !== $request->get('sort')) {
                $this->app()->sortQuery($query, $request->get('sort'), $user);
            } else {
                $this->app()->applyDefaultSort($query, $user);
            }

            $results = $query->paginate($pageLength);
            $records = $this->app()->filterViewable($results, $user);
            $records->transform(function ($r) use ($user) {
                return $this->app()->asTableData($r, $user);
            });
            //reset the keys so that php will serialize this as a javascript list, not an object.
            $records->setCollection($records->getCollection()->values());

            return $records;
        }
        $headers = array_values($this->app()->getActiveTableHeaders($user)->all());

        //if the application is using server-rendered tables instead of fancy js automatic tables
        if (collect($this->app()->getColumnDefs())->flatten()->count() > 0) {
            $records = [];
        } else {
            $records = $this->filteredViewable($request)->paginate($this->app()->pageLength());

        }
        $saveForLater = AppRecord::with('creator')
                            ->has('recordWorkflows', '=', 0)
                            ->where('application_name', $this->app()->appName)
                            ->where('creator_person_id', $user->person_id)
                            ->get();

        return view($this->appView('index'), [
            'myApprovals'  => $this->myApprovals($request),
            'filters'      => $this->app()->mainFilters($request),
            'tableHeaders' => $headers,
            'records'      => $records,
            'saveForLater' => $saveForLater
        ]);
    }

    public function mine(Request $request)
    {

        $person = $this->getPerson($request);
        $headers = array_values($this->app()->getActiveTableHeaders($person)->all());
        $featuringMe = $this->filteredViewable($request)
            ->where(function ($query) use ($person) {
                return $query->where(['creator_person_id' => $person->person_id])
                    ->orWhere(['subject_person_id' => $person->person_id]);
            })
            ->paginate(config("svna.paginate_length"));
        return view($this->appView('index'), [
            'myApprovals' => $this->myApprovals($request),
            'records'     => $featuringMe,
            'filters'     => $this->app()->mainFilters($request),
            'tableHeaders' => $headers,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Show the form for creating a new resource.
     */
    public function create(Request $request)
    {
        if (!$this->app()->canCreateRecord($request->user())) {
            abort(401, 'You do not have permission to create a record in this application');
        }

        $prepopulated = $this->app()->prepopulateCreateForm($request,
            $request->user());

        return view($this->appView('create'), [
            'form' => $this->getCreateForm($request),
            'prepopulated' => $prepopulated
        ]);
    }


    /**
     * Store a newly created resource in storage.
     */
    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $person = $this->getPerson($request);

        if (!$this->app()->canCreateRecord($person)) {
            return abort(401, 'You do not have permission to create a record in this application');
        }

        $form = $this->getCreateForm($request);
        $request->validate($form->validationRules());
        
        $newRecord = new AppRecord();
        $newRecord->application_name = $this->appName;
        $newRecord->creator()->associate($person);
        $formData = $form->asFormData($request);
        $appValidation = $this->app()->validateNewRecord($newRecord, $formData,
            $person);
        if ($appValidation !== true) {
            return Redirect::back()->with('error', $appValidation);
        }

        if (array_key_exists('subjectPerson', $formData->form_data) &&
            isset($formData->form_data['subjectPerson']['person_id'])) {
            $subjectPerson = $formData->form_data['subjectPerson']['person_id'];
            $newRecord->subject_person_id = $subjectPerson;
        }
        $newRecord->save();

        $formData->app_record_id = $newRecord->app_record_id;
        $formData->created_by = $person->person_id;
        $newRecord->formData()->save($formData);
        $newRecord->refresh();
        $this->app()->onSubmit($newRecord);
        $this->app()->onCreate($newRecord);
        $newUrl = $newRecord->url();

        $primaryWorkflow = $this->app()->primaryWorkflow();
        if ($primaryWorkflow != null) {
            $workflowResult = $primaryWorkflow->beginWorkflow($newRecord,
                $person);
            if ($workflowResult->status == 'error') {
                return redirect($newUrl)->with('error',
                    $workflowResult->message);
            }
        }

        return redirect($newUrl)->with('success',
            $newRecord->displaySubject() . "\n Created successfully!");
    }
